resources.string: Sign in to DeepSeek and see your balance.
This harness can\'t sign in to DeepSeek. It may be an older version, or its account plugin is turned off.
Sign in with your DeepSeek account to use it on this harness. Your projects and files stay where they are.
Your DeepSeek sign-in ended. Sign in again to keep using it.
The last sign-in timed out. Start again when you\'re ready.
The harness couldn\'t reach DeepSeek. Check its internet connection and try again.
The harness couldn\'t save the sign-in. Check that it has free space and can write to its folder.
DeepSeek\'s answer wasn\'t one the harness could use. Try again.
Sign in on the harness computer

The sign-in ends by sending the browser back to the harness through an address that only works on the same device. From this phone that device is the phone, not the harness. Finish the sign-in on the computer that runs the harness: open it there, go to Settings, then Account, and sign in. This page updates when it\'s done.
Finish signing in in your browser, then come back to this app.
Waiting for the sign-in to finish on the harness computer.
No browser opened. Copy the link and open it in a browser yourself.
The sign-in link can\'t be used. Try again to get a new one.
Account details aren\'t available right now.
Signing out doesn\'t delete any data. You can sign in again.
Tasks are running with this account. Signing out stops them.
Couldn\'t check for running tasks. Signing out may stop tasks that use this account.
The harness couldn\'t do that. Try again.
Couldn\'t reach the harness. Nothing was changed.
